title: DeepSeekMoE: Towards Ultimate Expert Specialization
authors: D. Dai, C. Deng, C. Zhao, et al. (17 authors)
before: MoE models used a handful of large experts with top-k routing.
problem: Coarse experts duplicate common knowledge and specialise poorly.
breakthrough: Many finer-grained experts plus a few always-on shared experts to hold common knowledge.
why: The architecture behind DeepSeek V2, V3 and R1, and the most copied MoE design of the current era.
next: DeepSeek-V2's latent attention, then V3 and R1.
inherits: Fine-grained plus shared experts as the modern MoE layout.
